name: Matua
serverNotes:
🇳🇿 📖 ABOUT: Crisp New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc from Matua, Marlborough. Classic Kiwi style that's always popular!

🍷 STYLE: Refreshing Sauvignon Blanc | Bright grapefruit, passion fruit & fresh-cut grass | High acidity, clean finish | Quintessential Marlborough.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Seafood, salads, goat cheese, oysters, fresh dishes.

💡 BY THE GLASS: Perfect aperitif! Zesty, tropical, and refreshingly crisp.

name: Jacques Dumont
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Loire Valley Sauvignon Blanc from France, rated 90 by Wine Enthusiast. Old World, mineral style.

🍷 STYLE: Crisp Loire Sauvignon Blanc | Citrus, gooseberry, cut grass & flint | Bright acidity, no oak | Clean, chalky finish

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Shrimp cocktail, fried calamari, goat cheese, salads, grilled salmon, haddock.

💡 BY THE GLASS: Pour it for guests who want this style without committing to a bottle.
